description: This file defines a factory pattern for creating different types of browser contexts in Playwright, including persistent, isolated, CDP, and remote contexts. It includes classes for each context type, utility functions for managing browser instances, and handles configuration options for launching browsers.

classes.name: BaseContextFactory
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing common logic for browser context factories, including browser acquisition and cleanup.

classes.name: IsolatedContextFactory
classes.description: Creates isolated browser contexts with specific launch options, including trace collection.

classes.name: CdpContextFactory
classes.description: Creates browser contexts connected over CDP protocol.

classes.name: RemoteContextFactory
classes.description: Creates browser contexts connected to remote endpoints.

classes.name: PersistentContextFactory
classes.description: Creates persistent browser contexts with user data directories, handling concurrent usage and cleanup.

methods.name: contextFactory
methods.description: Factory function that returns an appropriate BrowserContextFactory based on configuration.

methods.name: _obtainBrowser
methods.description: Retrieves or launches a browser instance, with caching and event handling.

methods.name: _doObtainBrowser
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to obtain specific browser instances.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context, returning it along with a close function.

methods.name: _doCreateContext
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new browser context from a browser instance.

methods.name: _closeBrowserContext
methods.description: Closes a browser context and possibly the browser if no other contexts exist.

methods.name: injectCdpPort
methods.description: Assigns a free port for CDP connection if using Chromium.

methods.name: startTraceServer
methods.description: Starts a trace viewer server if tracing is enabled.

methods.name: createHash
methods.description: Generates a short SHA-256 hash of input data.
